name: survos/ai-embed-bundle
description: Model-aware embedding requests, reusable vector caches and document embedding workflows for Symfony.

suggest.survos/workflow-messenger-bundle: Entity-independent queued and batched requests (planned integration).
suggest.survos/ai-duckdb-store: Required when using the DuckDB cache backend (also requires native ext-pdo_duckdb).
suggest.league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3: Optional S3 snapshot storage; reuse an existing Flysystem service via remote_storage instead if available.
